title: Rasen Falcon LDAP identity role: first concrete sealed-namespace consumer
summary: Deployment dev5 packages the owned LDAP Identity dev22 service plus an already verified dependency namespace into the existing Rasen Falcon identity-role release shape. A Deployment-owned launcher verifies the namespace and replaces ambient REXX_PATH before executing the LDAP-owned bootstrap; identity, LDAP, TLS, authorization, secret and activation authority remain outside Deployment.
invariants: LDAP Identity owns daemon/bootstrap semantics; General Deployment owns exact staging, namespace and launch mechanics only.
The generated rasenfalcon-ldap.service retains LDAP-owned hardening and changes only ExecStart to the namespace-verifying launch seam.
Ambient REXX_PATH must not select production LDAP dependencies.
The identity role carries ready:ldap_bind, e2e:ldap_revoke and e2e:sign_verify_revoke acceptance names exactly.
Missing live revoke or Crypto/PKI probes are NOT_RUN/fail-closed; fixture PASS is not commissioning evidence.
Production ldap.env, secret mappings, private keys, certificate issuance, service start and cutover remain operator/Secret Broker/PKI authority.

provenance.claim: Defines the concrete identity-role packaging and authority boundary.
LDAP-owned deployment contribution requires General Deployment to install the complete sealed namespace under /opt/rasenfalcon/ldap.
Records the dev5 programme integration and role-specific NOC/Office HTTPS unit requirement.
